text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm. When you celebrate every year, 
it really gets tough to pick birthday 
presents, yes~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's fine, it's fine! Just knowing 
you wanted to celebrate is plenty!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, everyone staying healthy 
without injuries every day and running 
together with me forever! That's the 
greatest present of all!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're right. I need to follow 
Tsuru-chan's example and be careful too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! Let's stay sound and healthy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... but still! I definitely want to 
give you a present, yes! It's your special 
birthday, after all, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have anything, desu~? Anything 
at all is fine, desu yo! Even El's special 
jalapeño, or anything!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Then... Ah! Would you like to 
taste-test my new health drink!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It might not be a physical object, 
but that sounds great! It'll make everyone 
healthy, and it helps me out too, so it's 
a win-win!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've gotten so used to the 
bitterness and spiciness that even when I 
taste-test it myself, I can't really tell 
anymore!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahhh! El just remembered she has 
urgent business—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Yes, of course. ...Then once 
you've handled that urgent business, we'll 
drink together, won't we? El♪
